name: Draw a Badge in SVG
description: Draw a gold release seal from SVG paths, circles and rotated letters instead of generating an image. Every shape stays editable, with no regeneration and no resampling.

data.comment:
# Draw a Badge in SVG

Draws a gold "Shipped" release seal from SVG elements instead of generating an image: a scalloped rosette, ribbon tails, lettering set around a ring, a check mark and stars. Every shape stays an element you can move or recolour later, with no regeneration and no resampling.

**How it works:** "1 Elements" is a Code node that returns the elements in paint order. The ribbon tails come first so the rosette covers their tops. The rosette is one path whose radius waves 36 times around the circle, and each letter of the ring text is its own text element, rotated to face outwards. "2 Document" wraps them in a 640 by 640 SVG canvas, and "3 SVG" shows the result. It runs locally with no model or key.

**Try this:** In "1 Elements", change the `phrase` around the ring or the `36` in the rosette path to 24 for broader scallops, then run again.
